subject: Adding clade labels based on interior node number issue

messages.author: 17361dced492a06b
messages.subject: Adding clade labels based on interior node number issue
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to add labels to select clades in my tree, based on their interior node number, but am receiving the error message that nodes are tips:

Warning messages:
1: Computation failed in `stat_clad_bar()`:
input node is a tip... 
2: Computation failed in `stat_clade_text()`:
input node is a tip... 

This is the code I used, which is close to what I found in the documentation:

library(ape)
library(ggtree)
tree<-read.nexus('Birdtree.tre')
ggtree(tree, layout='circular') + geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip, label=node), hjust=-.3) + geom_tiplab()
p <- ggtree(tree) + xlim(NA, 6)
p+geom_cladelabel(node=45, label="Pittidae")

I can't figure out where the problem is; in the tree input format, tree file, or am I overlooking something in the code?
Thanks for any help,

-Paul van Els

messages.author: 168ba93d93d9d7d7
messages.subject: Re: Adding clade labels based on interior node number issue
parts:
It is always a bit hard to tell without the actual data. Are you using data(bird.families) from the ape package?

You can check what is inside of "45" by: p$data[45,]

What is the return of the MRCA funtion when you supply all tip labels of your clade (if you select carefully 2 are enough)? This should return the node you have to use with cladelabel.

MRCA(p,c("label1","label2"))

Greetings,
Andreas
